gate_type: D-DAY TRACK B — BOTTLED WATER 2D TARGET-LINE SKIN
objective: Create a dedicated Bottled Water 2D visual skin for the already-running B2 target line, reusing existing VF UI/rendering mechanics (SVG canvas/viewport, pan/zoom, selection + inspector, animation clock/polling, runtime control wiring, state highlighting, B2 generic line facts) while providing workspace-specific bottled-water station artwork. No TIPA ASSY artwork, icons, APxx semantics or factory layout may be reused. The UI must bind to the B2 Bottled Water runtime, not mocked data.
explicit_non_objectives: No Water Treatment / Utilities / Warehouse simulation (B4)
No PlantOS integration or MQTT redesign (B6)
No manual MES/operator workflows (no quality decision, release, retry, rework, checklist, approval)
No downtime/failure code entry (belongs to the later abnormal/downtime slice)
No changes to B2 line semantics unless a visual blocker is proven
No generic snapshot or observation-architecture redesign
No material rewrite of the existing TIPA ASSY UI
No fix of the unrelated flaky reset test or the PR-state normalization debt
baseline_semantics_note: As for DDAY-B2/C01: the harness compares 'expected_base_sha' to origin/main and diffs it against HEAD, so it must be origin/main. 'sa_expected_baseline_sha' is the baseline issued in Issue #104 and was verified equal to the branch head before the first B3 write.
allowed_paths_note: Entries after CURRENT.md are frozen DDAY-B1/B2/B2-C01 artifacts already committed on this branch (plus the C01 harness repair and the B2-modified line_runtime.py) and therefore present in the diff against origin/main; they are listed only so the harness allowlist diff check is truthful and are NOT authorized for modification in B3. The B3-scope changed-file check against the B3 baseline f311ede in the evidence proves which files B3 actually touched (6 files).
sa_allowed_paths: src/virtual_factory/ui/static/ for new Bottled Water UI assets and minimal shared UI reuse
src/virtual_factory/ui/api.py only if required for Bottled Water runtime selection / line-facts/control endpoints
src/virtual_factory/assembly/demo_controller.py only if a very small generic read/control seam is required
required_deliverables: src/virtual_factory/ui/static/bottled_water_demo.js — workspace-specific skin with bottled-water station artwork, bottle/unit tokens, flow, controls and inspector
src/virtual_factory/ui/api.py — minimal domain-neutral Bottled Water endpoints: page, static, line-facts projection, and START/PAUSE/RESUME/STOP/RESET/ADVANCE control
tests/test_dday_b3_bottled_water_ui.py — API, projection, control-semantics, isolation and skin-asset tests
required_tests: B3-1 Bottled Water UI route reachable and bound to the B2 runtime (not mocked)
B3-2 all 8 frozen stations present in correct order
B3-3 Bottled Water skin is visually distinct: no APxx/TIPA visual vocabulary in the BW UI assets or API projection
B3-4 unit movement facts correspond to runtime positions
B3-5 START/PAUSE/RESUME/STOP/RESET work through the API and preserve B2 semantics
B3-6 total/good/reject and line state visible and tracking runtime facts
B3-7 Inspection PASS/FAIL/reject observable without manual disposition
B3-8 station/unit selection context available without adding manual decisions
B3-9 no B4/B5/B6/B7 implementation mixed in
B3-10 relevant UI/API/runtime regression tests pass
B3-11 full suite passes (or a pre-existing flaky failure is reproduced/disclosed separately and the exact-head rerun is green)

required_smoke_checks.description: Live HTTP smoke against the real B3 app: BW page served, state projection bound to the B2 runtime, all 8 stations in order, START/PAUSE/RESUME/STOP/RESET semantics, inspection indication, no TIPA/APxx vocabulary.
B2 runtime regression smoke (must remain green: B3 must not change line semantics).
